meta.title: Cherryz | Business Internet at the best price, everywhere in Cameroon
meta.description: Cherryz brings together the offers of the major operators (Camtel, Orange, MTN) for a dedicated, stable connection at up to 50% less. Business Internet with a public IP, and revenue-generating WiFi Zones.

hero.lead: Cheaper business Internet or a profitable WiFi Zone: Cherryz puts Camtel, Orange, MTN and others in competition, then delivers the best solution, anywhere in Cameroon.

meta.title: Business Internet with a dedicated public IP | Cherryz
meta.description: Dedicated business Internet with a fixed IP, from 45,000 XAF per Mbps per month. Multi-operator (Camtel, Orange, MTN), fast installation with no civil works, dedicated IP included, trial before you commit.

hero.title: Dedicated Internet. Fixed IP.
hero.lead: Cherryz picks the best infrastructure for you among our partner operators (Camtel, Orange, MTN) and delivers a business connection with a dedicated IP, with no works and no downtime.

ip.title: What is a dedicated public IP?
ip.lead: Your public IP address is your company's identity on the Internet. You need it to run your most sensitive business tools.
ip.point: With Cherryz, your IP is dedicated: nobody else shares it, and your bandwidth is guaranteed at all times.

vpn.title: Secure VPNs between branches
vpn.text: Link your sites in complete confidentiality.

cctv.title: Real-time video surveillance
cctv.text: Your cameras, viewable wherever you are.

features.title: A business connection, without an operator's constraints.

multiOperator.title: Multi-operator
multiOperator.text: We choose the best network for your location, not the one of a single provider.

fastInstall.title: Fast installation
fastInstall.text: Microwave links: no civil works, no trenches.

dedicatedIp.title: Dedicated IP included
dedicatedIp.text: Your own address. Nobody else shares it.

trial.title: Side-by-side trial

meta.title: Turnkey, revenue-generating WiFi Zone | Cherryz
meta.description: Launch your WiFi business: building, neighbourhood, hotel, campus, market… Cherryz surveys, sizes, deploys and automates the billing (vouchers, mobile money). ART-licensed, local after-sales support.

hero.title: Launch your WiFi business.
hero.lead: Building, neighbourhood, hotel, campus, market: Cherryz takes you from the idea to a profitable business. We survey, size, deploy and automate the payments.

zones.title: Whatever the size, we scale it.
zones.lead: Every space has its own density, range and way of paying. We design the WiFi Zone for yours.
zones.point: Got a space and an ambition? That's all we need to get started.

deployment.title: Deployment

deployment.outcome: A working WiFi Zone, ready to sell.

automation.title: Automation
automation.text: We set up automatic billing: mobile money, vouchers, portal.
automation.outcome: Your customers pay and you collect, with no manual work.
